nameEn: Manufacture of basic iron and steel
description: This class includes the manufacture of basic iron and steel and ferro-alloys.
includes: operation of blast furnaces, steel converters, rolling and finishing mills
manufacture of pig iron and spiegeleisen in pigs, blocks or other primary forms
manufacture of ferrous products by direct reduction of iron ore and other spongy ferrous products
manufacture of iron of exceptional purity by electrolysis or other chemical processes
manufacture of granular iron and iron powder
manufacture of steel in ingots or other primary forms
manufacture of semi-finished products of steel: blooms, billets, slabs, sheet bars
manufacture of hot-rolled and cold-rolled flat-rolled products of steel
manufacture of hot-drawn bars and rods of steel
manufacture of open sections of steel by hot-rolling, drawing or extrusion
manufacture of wire rod of steel
manufacture of tubes, pipes and hollow profiles of steel by hot-rolling, drawing or extrusion
manufacture of railway and tramway track construction material of steel: rails, check-rails, rack rails, switches, crossing frogs, point rods
excludes: manufacture of tubes and hollow profiles by cold drawing, see 2420
manufacture of cold-rolled flat products, see 2420
manufacture of wire drawn from rods, see 2420
